description: Run a script on Linux instances to create profile details

AccessKeyId.description: (Required) AccesskeyID to store evidence details in S3.

SecretAccessKey.description: (Required) SecretAccessKey to store evidence details in S3

SessionToken.description: (Required) SessionToken to store evidence details in S3.

runCommand: #!/bin/bash
# Amazon Linux 2 tool pre-seed. This mirrors the failure contract of its
# AL2023 sibling: the step exits non-zero when it cannot produce an artifact,
# rather than warning and exiting 0. It previously reached the end and reported
# success whether or not lime-<kernel>.ko had ever been built, so the tools
# loader custom resource reached CREATE_COMPLETE with nothing usable in the
# bucket. Note Amazon Linux 2 is end of life; prefer an AL2023 builder.
# Upstream versions, pinned. An unpinned clone builds whatever is at the tip of
# the default branch on the day of the incident - into the tooling that produces
# and reads forensic evidence. These match the pins already used by the
# acquisition and investigation documents so that one release means one set of
# tool versions. Note 504ensicsLabs/LiME redirects to jtsylve/LiME, its original
# author; cloning the old path works only while GitHub honours that redirect.
LIME_REF=v1.12.0
VOL3_REF=v2.28.0
set -o pipefail
fail() { echo "TOOL_BUILD_FAILED: $1" >&2; exit 1; }
cd /tmp || fail 'cannot enter /tmp'
sudo rm -rf forensic-tools-builder
mkdir -p forensic-tools-builder || fail 'cannot create the work directory'
cd forensic-tools-builder || fail 'cannot enter the work directory'
sudo yum update -y
# The LiME Makefile below needs a compiler and the headers for the running
# kernel. Neither is present on a stock Amazon Linux AMI, so without these
# `make` failed and only the source zips reached S3 - never lime-<kernel>.ko.
sudo yum install git gcc make zip -y || fail 'unable to install the build tools'
if [ "$(rpm -qa | grep -c awscli)" -eq 0 ]; then sudo yum -y install awscli || fail 'unable to install the aws cli'; fi
if [ "$(lsmod | grep -c lime)" -gt 0 ]; then sudo rmmod lime; fi
kernel_release=$(uname -r)
# Amazon Linux names kernel sub-packages per kernel line from the 6.12 line
# onwards, and keeps the unversioned name on older lines.
kernel_line=$(echo "$kernel_release" | cut -d. -f1,2)
sudo yum install "kernel${kernel_line}-devel-${kernel_release}" -y || sudo yum install "kernel-devel-${kernel_release}" -y || fail "no kernel-devel package for ${kernel_release}"
test -d "/lib/modules/${kernel_release}/build" || fail "no kernel build tree for ${kernel_release} - cannot compile LiME"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID={{AccessKeyId}}
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY={{SecretAccessKey}}
export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN={{SessionToken}}
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION={{Region}}
aws configure set default.s3.max_concurrent_requests 20
git clone --depth 1 --branch "$LIME_REF" https://github.com/jtsylve/LiME.git || fail "LiME clone of $LIME_REF failed"
zip -q -r LiME.zip LiME || fail 'LiME source archive failed'
test -s LiME.zip || fail 'LiME source archive is empty'
aws s3 cp LiME.zip s3://{{s3bucket}}/tools/LiME/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control || fail 's3 upload of the LiME source failed'
echo s3 copy of LiME complete
cd LiME/src || fail 'LiME source tree missing'
make || fail 'LiME module build failed'
# Only upload a module that actually built. Copying unconditionally used to
# publish nothing on failure while the step still reported success.
test -s "lime-${kernel_release}.ko" || fail "LiME build produced no lime-${kernel_release}.ko"
aws s3 cp "lime-${kernel_release}.ko" s3://{{s3bucket}}/tools/LiME/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control || fail 's3 upload of the LiME module failed'
cd /tmp/forensic-tools-builder || fail 'cannot return to the work directory'
git clone --depth 1 --branch "$VOL3_REF" https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility3.git || fail "volatility3 clone of $VOL3_REF failed"
zip -q -r volatility3.zip volatility3 || fail 'volatility3 source archive failed'
test -s volatility3.zip || fail 'volatility3 source archive is empty'
aws s3 cp volatility3.zip s3://{{s3bucket}}/tools/volatility3/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control || fail 's3 upload of the volatility3 source failed'
echo s3 copy of volatility3 complete
ls -ltr
exit 0;
